text: What I like - great pigment density that creates a very smooth presentation on canvas. Color selection is problematic as you are paying for many dark tones you are less likely to use - With the exception of some shadows I emptied the first three tubes without even opening the last two darker tubes. Next time I will buy single tubes as I realize now I was paying for tubes I will be unlikely to use.
title: Good paint but color range to broad
